Hi Team,

Finance has a concern related to the pilot rollout for internationally billed equipment.

For a subset of high-value inventory, we may need a billing presentation approach that works more cleanly across more than one currency context. The current specification covers general pricing and billing expectations, but it does not go into much detail about how pilot-specific currency presentation or conversion rules should be handled in customer-facing outputs.

title: Conversion precision maintained across multiple currency pairs
gherkin:
Feature: Multi-currency conversion integrity
  Scenario: Conversion precision maintained for different currency pairs
    Given conversion rates for multiple currency pairs
      | From | To  | Rate   |
      | USD  | EUR | 0.92   |
      | USD  | GBP | 0.79   |
      | USD  | JPY | 110.50 |
    When amounts are converted using these rates
    Then each stored amount matches its corresponding display amount
    And no rounding discrepancies appear between storage and display
rationale: Ensures that multi-currency conversion maintains integrity across different currency pairs, preventing precision loss that could create mismatches between stored and displayed values.
usedContextItems: Multi-currency conversion must maintain integrity between stored financial records and customer-facing display totals

Best,
Finance Dept.
